F01.note: With a panel open, a GOAL strip sits above it: the goal in full and a NOW line with the next step ('Your Farm: under construction'). Clicking it closes the panel and shows the full Goals card. Still open: nothing yet says the farm's crops become the food the goal asks for

F04.note: The plant now names the loop and the way out: 'it waits for this plant's own power. A load of wood chips is on the way from your Sawmill (3.1 km): about 8 hours, and that gets both going.'

F05.note: One unit everywhere a player sees goods: loads a day. Crates are gone from the town panel; the works key reads '10 loads, iron ore a day, can 10'; Economy rows are loads; the chart caption says 'full pace, N loads a day'

F10.note: With the Farm in hand the 'Start a food chain' tip steps aside; Tool options say how to place it

F11.note: Both placement rules now sit together in Tool options: 35% fertile soil, and within 400 m of a road it lays its own street

F15.note: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums restored on the cash and clock values (the font shorthand on <b> had reset it)

F16.note: Each Economy row is a ratio bar of made against what your works can make, with the figure as 'X of Y'. Steel 0 of 4 is empty, Crops 4 of 6 is two thirds

F17.note: The 24 hourly strips are gone; the section header says what the bar means: 'Made, last 24 hours · loads, of what your works can make'

F19.note: Demolish moved out of the header into a footer at the bottom of every works panel, far from Close, still two clicks

F20.note: The rate under a red status is no longer green, and a works short of power is never promoted to 'all it can'. 'can' is already the full-power figure

F21.note: One phrase for the state: the level line now reads 'held back: No power' under 'No power'

F22.note: No good green under a red status

F23.note: Level track now a plate-3 fill with a brass pinstripe, 5 px

F24.note: Body text is a fluid token: 14 px at 1600 wide, 15 px at 1920. The status sentences now follow it

F25.note: Need bars share one scale: each track's length is the want against the town's biggest want, so Food (518) runs full width and Fuel (69) is a short track

F27.note: At far zoom a town shows one summary chip ('Short of 5 needs', or 'Needs food and planks' for one or two) with a single alarm disc; the icon row only shows closer in. Industry map badges went from 13 to 16 px

F28.note: The radio is labelled now (RADIO kicker over the tune, new radio icon). The seven top-bar icons still have no visible labels; that part was not in this task

F29.note: Every lower-case run is 14 px or more; 12 px is kept only for short uppercase kickers and the SVG chart axis labels

F31.note: The ticker reads as a radio: RADIO kicker, the tune in quotes ('“Alder Run Rag”') or 'Tuning in', 'Off', 'Sound muted'

F34.note: Sizes are now 12 (kickers), 14 body, 18 titles, 24 headlines; at 1920 the body and titles step to 15 and 20. Was 12, 13, 13.7, 14, 16, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21

F41.note: No overlap at far zoom: one chip under each plate

F42.note: Quimbyton's five icons give way to 'Short of 5 needs' at far zoom; at mid zoom the discs are spaced 10 px with the '!' tucked bottom-right
